recommendations.name: Metricool Starter pilot
recommendations.operation: Six-channel social planning, publishing and reporting
recommendations.status: NOT DECISION-READY — BOARD, PERMISSIONS, CURRENT PRICE AND VALUE BASELINE REQUIRED
recommendations.cost: Official starting price €16/month on annual billing for up to five brands; X is a separate $10/month connected-account add-on.
recommendations.expectedImpact: One calendar and reporting surface for Instagram, LinkedIn, YouTube, TikTok, Threads and X; reduces manual scheduling and makes five daily units auditable.
recommendations.whyThisOne: Starter supports one LAiDIES profile per network, unlimited publishing, LinkedIn, historical analytics, reports and Canva/Drive integration. It fits one brand better than an API platform.
recommendations.smallestProof: Use a trial or one-month reversible pilot with Instagram and LinkedIn first; schedule one admitted seven-day board and compare time saved, failures and reporting usefulness.
recommendations.proofOfValue: At least 35 admitted units scheduled in one week, zero lost approvals, publishing success recorded by channel and at least two useful performance decisions surfaced.
recommendations.risks: Platform permissions, token expiry, X add-on cost, automation mistakes and analytics-definition drift.
recommendations.aliDecision: None yet. Return only after the first 35-unit board, exact connected-account permissions, current price and manual-work baseline are ready.

recommendations.name: Plausible Business
recommendations.operation: Automatic audience metrics in Control Room
recommendations.cost: Price varies by monthly pageviews; Business includes the Stats API.
recommendations.expectedImpact: Authorized aggregate visitors, page rankings, funnels and returning behaviour can populate the dashboard without manual copying.
recommendations.whyThisOne: The tracker is already embedded. Upgrading only makes sense if the current plan lacks Stats API access and the API materially closes the operating loop.
recommendations.smallestProof: Use the Business trial or existing account access to pull one read-only 30-day aggregate into the dashboard.
recommendations.proofOfValue: The dashboard updates visitors, top/low pages and one decision-ready growth opportunity with timestamped definitions.
recommendations.risks: Paying for an API before definitions, account access and owner action are ready.
recommendations.aliDecision: Do not upgrade until the current Plausible plan and pageview tier are confirmed.

recommendations.name: Supabase Pro
recommendations.operation: Reliable production Resident Card identity and account-backed state
recommendations.cost: Official price starts at US$25/month; includes a first project, daily backups and projects that do not pause.
recommendations.expectedImpact: Removes free-project pausing and adds production-oriented capacity, logs and backups once the identity vertical is actually accepted.
recommendations.whyThisOne: It supports a real production dependency, but a paid plan cannot fix unresolved Auth, RLS, merge, revoke, delete or cross-device product logic.
recommendations.smallestProof: Complete the authorized isolated Auth/RLS/two-device suite on the existing candidate before upgrading production.
recommendations.proofOfValue: Accepted identity vertical, documented backup/recovery, no direct-write bypasses and a measured production readiness need.
recommendations.risks: Premature spend, data responsibility and treating infrastructure availability as product correctness.
recommendations.aliDecision: Approve only after Platform returns the isolated proof and exact production project/cost record.

recommendations.name: Ayrshare Premium
recommendations.expectedImpact: Would provide an API-first publishing layer, but duplicates cheaper scheduling/reporting capability for the current one-brand operation.
recommendations.whyThisOne: It becomes relevant only if LAiDIES needs its own fully programmatic multi-network publishing product, not merely a strong internal content calendar.
recommendations.smallestProof: None now. Reconsider only after a scheduler pilot proves an API limitation that blocks the five-a-day engine.
recommendations.proofOfValue: A named automation requirement that cannot be met by Metricool/Buffer and saves more than the monthly cost plus maintenance.
recommendations.risks: High fixed cost, platform-policy dependency and building automation before editorial approval is stable.
